name: Acqualagna (Italy)
description: Seven horizontal stripes of red and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Acqualagna (a bird on blue above red) within branches, with the inscription COMUNE DI ACQUALAGNA in white arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Acqualagna, a comune in Marche; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Acqualagna arms — bird on blue above red, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI ACQUALAGNA arched above the arms
